_comment: Hard policy gates for the autopilot. See docs/adr/0005-hooks-and-stop-conditions.md.

PreToolUse.description: Reject `any`, money-as-number, TODO outside /scratch, and any .env* except .env.example.
Hard-block rm -rf, DROP, force-push, gh repo delete, vercel env rm.
Hard-block writes to /.automerge-authorized or env lines containing AUTOMERGE.
Block gh pr merge without --admin AND without authenticated user JWT in call context.
Hard-block commits modifying Tier-3 paths; file BLOCKER. Bypass requires AUTOMERGE_AUTHORIZED + signed /.automerge-authorized.
Block writes to opportunities table with greenlit_by_user_id set by anything other than a real user JWT.

PostToolUse.description: Queue typecheck after Write to packages/**/src/**
Trigger HISTORIAN to write a phase doc on PR creation.
